author: N6rL
content: Blocked by L2 (toolchain must exist) and L3 (mypy/pyright choice must be settled first). Scope: configure ruff (lint+format, replaces black/isort/flake8), the chosen type checker at strict/max mode (no implicit Any, no untyped defs), pytest with basic config, and pre-commit hooks for the fast-local checks per the blocking matrix decided in L3. AC: ruff check passes on empty modules; type checker passes in strict mode on empty modules; pytest runs and passes (0 tests ok); pre-commit install works and runs clean. Mutation testing tool (mutmut or cosmic-ray) identified in L3 but does not need to be fully configured here — just the fast-local pipeline.
